title: Captive observability bridge for air-gapped Dedicated clusters
creator: Marcus Li
description: Build a 'captive bridge' component that enables secure, pull-based export of traces, metrics, and logs from air-gapped Dedicated / Private deployments into Redwood's hosted observability pipeline without requiring an always-online outbound connection. The bridge should support on-disk encrypted spooling, tenant-aware envelopes, sensitive field scrubbing, and a signed bundle format that the hosted relay can verify before ingestion. This ticket covers the prototype agent, server-side bundle verification, and a CI-driven packaging flow for air-gapped bundle distribution to customer clusters.
acceptance_criteria: Agent can spool OTLP traces/metrics/logs to disk in encrypted chunks and rotate files when exceeding size or time thresholds
Bundle format is signed with Redwood key and contains tenant_id, shard metadata, and per-span minimal context to avoid PII exposure
Hosted relay verifies signature, validates envelope, and ingests into existing OTEL pipeline with provenance tags
Per-tenant retention and sampling metadata preserved and applied post-ingest
End-to-end demo with a test private cluster: produce traces -> offline bundle pulled -> hosted relay ingests -> visible in latency/error dashboards
technical_notes: Agent will implement Otel receiver and write encrypted protobuf files to a configurable spool directory; use AES-GCM with per-file nonces and tenant-scoped keys (KMIP/KMS integration TBD)
Bundle schema v1: JSON header + gzipped protobuf payloads + manifest.json + signed manifest (ed25519). Avoid embedding raw request bodies or headers by default (redaction policy applied)
Backpressure: implement a per-tenant token-bucket limiter that drops low-priority metrics and aggregates high-cardinality logs when spool exceeds soft_threshold
Failure modes: if signed bundle fails verification, relay moves bundle to quarantine bucket and emits an audit event; implement retryable error codes for transient bundle corruption
Performance: microbenchmark disk write throughput on t3.large and nvme-ssd types; aim for sustained 120 MB/s spool across 4 worker threads without blocking application network threads
testing_plan: Unit tests for bundle signing/verification, integration test that runs an isolated private cluster in CI, synthetic trace/metric generation that validates correct tenant tags and redaction, soak run to validate spool rotation and backpressure behavior. Include chaos test where bundle corruption is injected to validate quarantine path.
rollout_plan: 1) Merge agent + relay PRs behind feature flag
2) Deploy relay verification in staging and validate with synthetic bundles
3) Package agent as air-gap bundle and run install on internal test cluster
4) Run end-to-end demo with Solutions Engineering; collect dashboard signals
5) Gradual customer beta with explicit support contract; monitor audit events and quarantine rate
